notes.title: Version 1.3.1
notes.content:
[h3]- Small changes made in world 2[/h3]

[h3]- The bouncing force when the player is on the edge of a platform is a little stronger[/h3]

[h3]- The sensitivity option for the mouse / joystick(controller) is slightly improved[/h3] 

[h3]- Some towers in the sci-fi world(5) are updated visually[/h3]

notes.title: Game Rebalancing & Adding More Futures
notes.content:
[h1]Controller Support[/h1]
[h3]The game now has partial controller support, which means the basic movement input has been implemented into the game (mouse is still required for some things like changing settings, closing the game etc.)[/h3]

                                                         [h1]More control while sprinting[/h1]
[h3]The game now haves more solid and reliable control while sprinting, plus some cool animation. Also the walking speed is a little faster.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009055/e348067b5cda24ed4a33db8397b6c77c020f1253.png[/img]
[h3]The stamina bar is updated and more accurate.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009055/3e151a322ccced4e254f16e6638f3faa8e056641.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009055/d2367b25b7891ebd29f003a75d70d8f0b53b31db.png[/img]
                                                         [h1]Adjustable Field of View[/h1]
[h3]The field of view (FOV) of the game can now be adjusted to a wishable value by the user.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009055/9e1337986862e01386a526259739f7ade824898b.png[/img]
                                                          [h1]Fixed some small bugs[/h1]
[h3]Resolved some issues like when the player has ran out of time just before reaching the end goal and still completing the level. 
Also in some levels even after reaching the goal and finishing the level the player still fails if he drops too far after the goal, that is no longer an issue.[/h3]

[h3]The tubes and lasers in the time trial "All In One" are lower than before and easier to jump.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009055/3a5a0a7aa1f6603a7dbfe186cbfc7c6ea9afa9df.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009055/bc70666a6dc033c3b656c573d4e59aade3f9ad0d.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=hpKAaeZ5Raw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
[h3]• Improved Visual Quality[/h3]
-[b] Better graphics.[/b]

[h3]• Improved Mechanics[/h3]
- [b]Better movement mechanics.[/b]
- [b]If you now get stuck on the edge of a platform or other object you get bounced up.[/b]

[h3]• New Stamina System[/h3]
- [b]The game now haves a stamina bar for the sprinting.[/b]

[h3]• New Achievement[/h3]
- [b]New achievement in the time trial mode[/b]

[h3]• Fixed Some Small Bugs[/h3]

notes.title: Small Issues Resolved
notes.content:
* Small Improvements.
* Fixed the issue with the moving platforms.
* Fixed the bug with the gravitational force time trial.

notes.title: Version 1.0 | Release date & more information
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=648zfLI2l5Y;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Aerial Platforms is first person platformer, where you complete levels under certain time, using agility and skills to jump on different objects while "the floor is lava" type of game.[/h2]

[b][h1]The game contains a campaign with total of 50 levels (5 worlds)[/h1][/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/7800d55f0e952cb776ffbb521f56f78f990e2a25.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/5f4ddd305ef6a327aa7af3d4283ecbbf82d6e12f.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/c6d8bf039a39303f77bab490a229f206dbc35bdc.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/db1785fcd1bd43de57c85c57bbcba449c2c98d72.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/5fa4277aa48e7ce332746a1f41577537d22994ba.png[/img]
[h2]Each world gets more and more complex and challenging.[/h2]
[h2]As you go through different worlds you will unlock new ability skills like an air dash and double jump as the levels will get more insane with all kind of obstacles to dodge.[/h2]

[h1][b]A separate mode with time trial levels with high-score system[/b][/h1]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/273a9becff95c3f79dc42c71fed73cdd1d5f6068.png[/img]
[h2]The time trial mode contains levels with high-score system (best time to beat the level)[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/691ee11d2040f337727e6cd5c8d8dc8e9d19aa54.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/566bcb60d6e844d8b6f2bf9799ba67374135a36e.png[/img]

[h2]* ADDITIONAL INFORMATION[/h2]

[h3]■ First when you open the campaign you will have total of 50 levels to complete the game. Total of 5 worlds.[/h3]

[h3]■ At the beginning there are no unlocked abilities. The first ability skill is unlocked from level 11.[/h3]

[h3]■ The time trial mode is open to play, but you won't have skills, unless you have unlocked them in the campaign.[/h3]

[b][h1]The game is available for Windows and Linux[/h1][/b]
